title: Write PLAN.md for jmap-mail-types
description: The crate has no PLAN.md. Every other crate in the workspace has one. PLAN.md documents: crate family position and dependency rules, what RFC sections are covered, what is intentionally out of scope (method handlers, parsing logic), key design decisions (MailboxRole custom serde, Email partial deserialization with all-Option fields, why FilterCondition uses an untagged enum for Filter), test oracle strategy (fixtures from RFC 8621 examples), and reference pointers to the spec sections.
